summary: IDF eliminated two Hamas commanders in Gaza City, including one involved in holding hostages Emily Damari, Romi Gonen, and Matan Angrest, while also destroying four Hamas and PIJ weapons warehouses across the Strip. Simultaneously, the Saudi-led coalition launched a broad operation in Yemen to dismantle the Houthi ballistic missile network, and an Israeli drone struck unusually deep in Lebanon near the Syrian border at Housh al-Sayyid Ali. Lebanese border areas experienced intensive Israeli artillery shelling and air strikes across multiple districts.
key_points: IDF eliminated Hamas Shati Battalion commander Muhammad Mahsen Namar Yazji, involved in holding hostages Damari, Gonen, Angrest in Gaza City. (Source: @New_security8200/204158)
IDF and Shin Bet destroyed four Hamas and PIJ weapons warehouses across Gaza containing rockets, IEDs, mortars, and Kalashnikovs. (Source: @idf_telegram/25322)
IDF eliminated three Hamas and PIJ operatives, including PIJ rocket unit commander Hossam Abu Al-Ata, for violating ceasefire. (Source: @almogboker78/18382)
Saudi-led coalition in Yemen began broad operation targeting Houthi elements and ballistic missile network. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8066)
Saudi warplanes struck oil company station in Bajil, Hodeidah governorate, Yemen. (Source: @SharghDaily/188433)
Saudi aviation used cluster bombs on Bani Hut villages in Abs district, Yemen. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/398323)
Israeli drone struck Housh al-Sayyid Ali in northeast Lebanon near Syrian border, unusually deep. (Source: @New_security8200/204162)
Lebanese daily report: 92 alerts, 62 drone detections, 5 air strikes, 15 artillery shelling incidents across southern districts. (Source: @redlinkleb/47240)

points: Bloomberg reports Iran maintains capability to produce and develop new missiles and UAVs, possesses large stockpile of ballistic missiles and anti-ship weapons, can rapidly replenish stockpiles even if war with US resumes, with Russia supplying additional missiles. (Source: @asafroz/54196)

Former President Trump claimed Iran was two to three weeks from nuclear weapon before US B-2 strikes, asserted Iran would target Israel, Middle East, Europe, and US cities like Los Angeles and San Diego if nuclear-armed, and stated US blocked Iran's nuclear progress. (Source: @VahidOnline/78675)

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced likely seizure of approximately $1 billion in Iranian-linked cryptocurrency assets by week's end, describing policy shift from "maximum pressure" to "complete isolation" encompassing financial, maritime, air, and land routes, with UAE and Oman cooperating and negotiations with Pakistan and Turkey to close land corridors. (Source: @VahidOnline/78670)
Unconfirmed reports indicate evacuation of some police stations in Tehran. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/82237)
Air defense activity detected in Yazd Province, Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/10891)

IDF eliminated Hamas Shati Battalion commander Muhammad Mahsen Namar Yazji in Gaza City, who was involved in holding hostages Emily Damari, Romi Gonen, and Matan Angrest in the Gaza City Brigade area. (Source: @New_security8200/204158)
IDF eliminated Hamas Daraj Tuffah Battalion terrorist Muhammad Fuzi Muhammad Awad Jamal in Sabra area, Gaza City. (Source: @New_security8200/204158)

IDF and Shin Bet destroyed four Hamas and PIJ weapons warehouses across Gaza Strip, containing dozens of rockets, IEDs, mortars, Kalashnikov rifles, and other combat equipment. (Source: @almogboker78/18383)

IDF eliminated three terrorists: PIJ rocket unit commander Hossam Walid Hassan Abu Al-Ata in Gaza City, PIJ operative Magdi Ma'in Yousef Al-Ayoubi in Gaza City, and Hamas company commander Muhammad Aja in Al-Furqan area, all for violating ceasefire. (Source: @almogboker78/18382)
Israeli drone struck Housh al-Sayyid Ali village in northeast Lebanon near Syrian border, described as unusually deep compared to routine strikes. (Source: @New_security8200/204162)
IDF operations in Gaza City eliminated two Hamas commanders linked to hostage holding and one Daraj Tuffah Battalion terrorist, all via airstrikes. (Source: @New_security8200/204158)
IDF and Shin Bet destroyed four weapons warehouses belonging to Hamas and PIJ across the Gaza Strip, eliminating stockpiles of rockets, IEDs, mortars, and small arms. (Source: @idf_telegram/25322)
IDF eliminated three Hamas and PIJ operatives, including a PIJ rocket unit commander, for promoting terror attacks and violating ceasefire. (Source: @almogboker78/18382)
A child succumbed to wounds sustained inside a displacement tent west of Gaza City. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/398331)
Israeli drone conducted unusually deep strike on Housh al-Sayyid Ali village in northeast Lebanon near the Syrian border. (Source: @New_security8200/204162)

Daily monitoring recorded 92 alerts, 62 drone detections, 5 air strikes (including Hariss, Kfar Tibnit, Al-Mansouri, Wadi Al-Hajir), and 15 artillery shelling incidents across southern districts including Nabatieh, Tyre, and Bint Jbeil. (Source: @redlinkleb/47240)
Drone strike reported on Housh al-Sayyid Ali in Hermel area. (Source: @redlinkleb/47240)

Artillery shelling hit Al-Mansouri (4), Wadi Al-Salouqi (3), Barashit (2), Nabatieh Al-Fawqa (1), Kfar Tibnit (1), Wadi Zabaqin (1), Mayfadoun (1), Hadatha (1), and Zoutar Al-Sharqiya (1). (Source: @redlinkleb/47240)
Israeli drone strike on Housh al-Sayyid Ali in northeast Lebanon occurred near the Syrian border, indicating potential cross-border operational reach. (Source: @New_security8200/204162)
No direct reports from Syria or Iraq in current messages.

Saudi-led coalition in Yemen announced broad operation targeting Houthi militia elements and capabilities, aiming to dismantle and destroy the Houthi ballistic missile network. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8066)
Saudi warplanes struck an oil company station in Bajil district, Hodeidah governorate, Yemen. (Source: @SharghDaily/188433)
Saudi aviation used internationally prohibited cluster bombs in strikes on Bani Hut villages in Abs district, Yemen. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/398323)
Yemen's armed forces claimed to have repelled a second advance by Saudi-backed forces toward Bab al-Mandab within hours, inflicting heavy casualties. (Source: @presstv/210178)

US Embassy in Jordan warned that Iranian-supported Houthis have attacked Saudi civilian airports and critical infrastructure, causing civilian casualties, with potential for rapid escalation and threats to US interests worldwide. (Source: @shin_persian/10883)
US Treasury Secretary Bessent stated UAE and Oman are cooperating with US "complete isolation" campaign against Iran, including closing maritime, air, and land routes. (Source: @VahidOnline/78670)
